note: Made-up test data. Not real listings: areas are real Aberdeen districts, but streets, house numbers and descriptions are invented, and postcodes use inward letters Royal Mail never issues (C, I, K, M, O, V), so they can't match a real address. A studio has 0 bedrooms. rentPcm is whole pounds per calendar month.

properties.description: A flat with an unusually long address, useful for checking that cards and list rows wrap neatly.

This generous three-bedroom apartment occupies the first floor of a handsome granite building on a quiet crescent, a few minutes' walk from the shops and restaurants of the West End and a short bus ride from the business parks, and it has been completely refurbished by its current owners to a very high standard. The shared entrance leads up a broad stone stair to a wide, bright hallway, where a run of fitted cupboards provides plenty of storage for coats, cases and golf clubs. At the front of the building, the living room stretches across the full width of the flat, with three tall sash windows, working shutters, restored cornicing and a marble fireplace with a gas stove. The dining kitchen sits to the rear and has been fitted with handmade timber units, stone worktops, an electric range cooker, a dishwasher, a washer-dryer and a large fridge-freezer, with room for a table that seats six. The main bedroom is a large double with a wall of built-in wardrobes and an en suite shower room with underfloor heating. The second bedroom is another good double, also with fitted wardrobes, and the third is a comfortable single that would suit a home office equally well. A family bathroom with a freestanding bath and a separate walk-in shower completes the accommodation. Outside, tenants share a well-kept rear garden with a drying area and a bike store, and there is one allocated parking space. The flat is let unfurnished, with gas central heating and double glazing to the rear. Sorry, no smokers. Available now for a minimum term of twelve months, subject to references and a deposit equal to five weeks' rent.
